The 1024->8192 bump is the fix that was adopted, not the one that was rejected. The Expected requirement is a few thousand entries with no noticeable memory cost, and the diff's own comment justifies 8192 as still tiny, which satisfies that. The rejected "even larger bump" was a still larger/unbounded cache that would have re-traded memory for speed.
took the rejected path: no
